name: 4-28-20 City Council Agenda (No Meeting)
agenda_text:
THE COUNCIL MEETING SCHEDULED FOR APRIL 28, 2020,
HAS BEEN CANCELED. THE NEXT SCHEDULED MEETING
WILL BE HELD ON MAY 5, 2020.

THE PUBLIC HEARING SCHEDULED FOR APRIL 28TH RE:
ESTABLISHING POLICIES FOR SHORT TERM RENTALS WILL
BE MOVED TO THE MAY 5TH COUNCIL MEETING.

SHOULD ANYONE FROM THE PUBLIC WISH TO SUBMIT
COMMENTS TO BE READ INTO THE RECORD REGARDING
THE PUBLIC HEARING, OR ANY OTHER MATTER ON THE
AGENDA, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR COMMENTS TO THE
FOLLOWING:

City Clerk, Yvonne Horton – yhorton@cityofinglewood.org

Deputy  City  Clerk,  Aisha  Thompson  –
aphillips@cityofinglewood.org
